subtitle.v: Phân bổ thu tiền cho các hóa đơn...

options.query: select ma_ttct, ten_ttct%l from dmttct where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and status = 1 order by stt

query.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @q nvarchar(4000) set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding set @strKey = @strKey + ' and ma_kh not in (select ma_kh from dmkh where nv_yn = 1)' set @q = 'update #v set da_pb_nt = b.tt_nt from #v a join (select ma_kh, ma_nt, id, sum(tt_nt) as tt_nt from ctct20 where loai_tt = 1 and id in (select id from #v) group by ma_kh, ma_nt, id) b on a.id = b.id and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and a.ma_nt = b.ma_nt' set @q = @q + ' update #v set cl_nt=tien_nt-da_pb_nt ' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, @q, @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId
